rationale: The Lean conclusion has the correct matrix defect, spectral norm, constants, squared condition number of the computed R prefix, prefix indexing, and quadratic treatment of the paper's suppressed higher-order term. Its CGS-P trace also reproduces the pythagorean diagonal. Nevertheless, the proposition is not the paper's Theorem 1 equation (7): it assumes a residual-asymptotics object containing exact versions of the companion conclusions used to prove (7), and it restricts attention to globally parameterized computation families with additional norm and condition radii. These are stronger hypotheses and a narrower domain, not a stronger theorem. The arithmetic trace also leaves several modeled operations outside the normalized-range guards. The result is therefore a nonvacuous but materially weaker specialization.
